cnpj.title: CNPJ
cnpj.description: The company number that was checked, digits only.

companyName.title: Company
companyName.description: Legal name (razao social) registered at the Receita Federal for this CNPJ, copied from the sanction record only when that record's own identifier has the 14 digits of the CNPJ asked about. Null when no record returned a matching CNPJ. Never the name of an individual: records about a natural person are discarded before this point and counted in personRecordsDiscarded.

tradeName.title: Trade name
tradeName.description: Nome fantasia registered at the Receita Federal for the same CNPJ, under the same 14-digit rule. Null when the registry does not carry one.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: clear = none of the four registries (CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, Acordos de Leniencia) returned a record for this CNPJ. flagged = at least one of them returned a record. error = the check could not be completed. A clear verdict is not a certificate of good standing.

findingsBySource.title: Records per source
findingsBySource.description: How many records came from each of the four registries.

findings.title: Records
findings.description: One entry per sanction record found in CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM or Acordos de Leniencia: the registry, the official link to the record, sanction type or impediment reason, scope, dates, sanctioning body, legal basis and publication. The four registries do not fill the same fields, so a field the registry left empty is absent from that record. Fields about individuals (name, CPF, partner, legal representative) are never included.

sourcesChecked.title: Sources checked
sourcesChecked.description: The four registries read for this row, each with its official API URL and publisher: CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM and Acordos de Leniencia.

example.label: CEIS
example.registry: CEIS - Cadastro de Empresas Inidoneas e Suspensas
example.publisher: Controladoria-Geral da Uniao (CGU) - Portal da Transparencia

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: When the check ran, ISO 8601 in UTC.

justification.title: Justification
justification.description: One sentence saying why the verdict is what it is, for your audit file.
justification.example: No sanction record was returned for CNPJ 00.000.000/0001-91 by CEIS and CNEP and CEPIM and LENIENCIA at 2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00; this is not a certificate of good standing and it covers only these federal registries.

dataAttribution.title: Data attribution
dataAttribution.example: Source: Portal da Transparencia, Controladoria-Geral da Uniao (CGU), Brazil. Open data under Creative Commons Attribution, Decreto 8.777/2016.

personRecordsDiscarded.title: Records about individuals discarded
personRecordsDiscarded.description: Records the registries returned about a natural person. They are counted and never published.

unmappedKeys.title: Unmapped API keys
unmappedKeys.description: Field names the API returned that this Actor does not publish. Names only, never values.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the check failed, when the verdict is error.
